tasks.title: Create the Next.js TypeScript project and RexSoft layer structure
tasks.dod: The project installs with pnpm, TypeScript strict mode is enabled, the app builds, and the web entry point boots.

tasks.title: Wire unit, component, browser, and accessibility test harnesses
tasks.dod: The empty unit/component suites run green and a browser smoke test proves that the application boots and accepts keyboard focus.

tasks.title: Establish CSS Modules and design-token foundations
tasks.dod: Global CSS custom properties and one CSS Module prove the styling pipeline; unknown visual tokens remain explicitly unresolved rather than fabricated.

tasks.title: Add Docker Compose development and production packaging
tasks.dod: The single web service builds and boots as a non-root container with a healthcheck and logging limits; no database or migration tool is introduced.

tasks.title: Install RexSoft frontend guidance and repository rules
tasks.dod: The rexsoft-frontend skill is installed with dereferenced references, AGENTS.md records real project commands and constraints, and no unresolved product-specific value is guessed.

tasks.title: Add the CI quality gate
tasks.dod: CI installs dependencies and passes typecheck, lint, test, browser smoke, and production build using the same documented commands as local development.
